title: Beginning of the 1962 Mexico City radiation accident
text: Between March and July 1962, a radiation incident in Mexico City occurred when a ten-year-old boy took home an industrial radiography source and removed it from its proper shielding. Five individuals received significant doses of radiation from the 200-gigabecquerel cobalt-60 capsule, four of whom died.

title: Roman Catholic Diocese of Apatzingan established.
text: The Diocese of Apatzingan is a Latin Church ecclesiastical territory or diocese of the Catholic Church in Mexico. It is a suffragan in the ecclesiastical province of the metropolitan Archdiocese of Morelia.

title: Rubén Jaramillo is assassinated in Morelos by the Mexican Army.
text: Rubén Jaramillo Méndez was a Mexican military and political leader of campesino origin who participated in the Mexican Revolution. After the Revolution, he continued to fight for the land reform promised under the Mexican Constitution.

title: Mexico defeats Yugoslavia in the Americas Zone final of the 1962 Davis Cup
text: The Mexico national football team represents Mexico in men's international football, and is governed by the Mexican Football Federation (Spanish: Federación Mexicana de Fútbol), the governing body for football in Mexico founded in 1927. It has been a full member of FIFA since 1929, is a founding member of CONCACAF which was founded in 1961, and is also a member of NAFU in the North American Zone.

title: 1962 World Modern Pentathlon Championships are held in Mexico City.
text: The 1962 World Modern Pentathlon Championships were held in Mexico City, Mexico.
